name: Brutal Swing
description: You swing your arms around violently, attacking anything within 5 feet of you. All creatures in range must make a DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE dark damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
higherLevels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.
